title: carex × luteola
intro: Carex × luteola, commonly known as the yellow sedge, is a hybrid plant species in the family Cyperaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Carex × luteola include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, to reduce inflammation, and to exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Carex × luteola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
